ORDINANCE



 BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

 SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-2,
 Neighborhood Shopping District; B1-3, Neighborhood Shopping District; B3-3,
 Community Shopping District; and C1-3, Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and
 indications as shown on Map No. 16-C and Map No. 18-C in the area bound by:

         South Merril Avenue; a line 61 .25 feet north of and parallel to East 71 st Street; the alley
         next east of and parallel to South Merrill Avenue; a line 77.32 feet north of and parallel to
         East 71 st Street; South Paxton Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to East 71 st
        Street; South Crandon Avenue; East 71 st Street; South Shore Drive; East 71 st Street; a
        line 59 feet south of and parallel to East 71 st Street; South Oglesby Avenue; the alley
        next south of and parallel to East 71 st Street; South Crandon Avenue; a line 98 feet
        south of and parallel to East 71 st Street; South Luella Avenue; a line 77.5 feet south of
        and parallel to East 71 st Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Luella
        Avenue; a line 98.1 feet south of and parallel to East 71 st Street; South Paxton Avenue;
        a line 75 feet south of and parallel to East 71 st Street; the alley next west of and parallel
        to South Paxton Avenue; a line 148.1 feet south of and parallel to East 71 st Street; South
        Merrill Avenue; a line 88 feet south of and parallel to East 71 st Street; the alley next west
        of and parallel to South Merrill Avenue and East 71 st Street,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




Common Address:
21 32-2238 E. 71 st Street
21 35-2325 E. 71 st Street
